_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-gcedram leakage testbench (issue #2).
family            sky130 PDK family (via volare -- a stock open_pdks
distribution, not a local fork)
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal
stack only; irrelevant to a device-level SPICE sim)
open_pdks_commit  the volare version hash this testbench and its
committed results are pinned against. Same pin as
2AMLogic/sky130-ldo and 2AMLogic/sky130-bandgap's
sim/pdk.json, reused unmodified -- no reason for a
device-model leakage study to diverge from the rest
of the fleet's PDK pin.
install_command   reproduces this exact install
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if $PDK_ROOT is unset
ngspice_lib       the combined ngspice model-library include, relative
to the variant dir -- this is the ONLY PDK file this
testbench references; no local model edits.
process_corners   the MOS corner sections this testbench sweeps,
verified against the .lib sections of
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice for this pinned
commit: tt/ss/ff/sf/fs are the standard MOS corners.
temperature_c     the temperature points this testbench sweeps, taken
from the naming convention of the shipped
libs.tech/irsim/*_{n40,27,125}.prm corner files and
matching the -40..125 C range
2AMLogic/sky130-bandgap's ratified spec uses for
temperature-corner claims.
